verdict.rationale: Webhook event subscriptions are a fair axis for an incident-management SaaS platform, but the evidence pack never mentions outbound webhooks or any event-subscription mechanism. Workflows have trigger events and 152 action types, but no cited action sends HTTP or webhook calls. The API docs cover only creating incidents and API keys, and the status-page API is pull-based JSON, so this is lack of evidence rather than a wrong axis.
